title: Kiddie Polish Cod Casserole
description: A dense and flavorful Polish dish featuring cod, infused oil, and kid-friendly ingredients, with a floral twist from dill and parsley.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the infused oil over medium heat.
Add the shredded carrot and zucchini to the skillet and cook until tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the milk, dill, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked cod fillets to the bowl and mix until the cod is well coated.
In a separate bowl, mix the flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the bowl with the cod and mix until the cod is well coated.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the cooked carrot and zucchini mixture in the bottom of the dish.
Add the cod mixture on top of the carrot and zucchini mixture.
Top the cod mixture with the remaining carrot and zucchini mixture.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
